address: rue de la Reffe 26, Remouchamps, 4920, Belgium
bio: This comforting inn is emblematic of the Ardennes countryside and of its history. Eight generations of Daussaint innkeepers have been at its helm since 1768! A wrought-iron pergola provides the romantic setting for a dinner for two featuring classical French fare: fried trout, lobster from the lobster tank, tournedos of venison… Delicious!...
